questions.question: Which of the following is India's highest civilian award?

options.explanation: Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in the Republic of India
The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India

questions.explanation: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India. Instituted in 1954, the award is conferred in recognition of "exceptional service/performance of the highest order" without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
